Frenano
Version VERSION
Frenano was built with one goal: to create a clean, reliable speedometer without the clutter.
No ads. No subscriptions. No account. Just a simple speedometer with automatic speed limit detection where available.
Built with the help of modern AI tools, but carefully designed, tested and refined by a human who believes simple software is often the best software.
Driving safely and respecting speed limits is always the responsibility of the driver.
Made in Switzerland 🇨🇭
Location
Off — location is needed to measure your speed
Open your browser’s site permissions for Frenano and choose Location.
